approach: Native x86-64 execution of the PS4 executable, reimplemented system libraries, Vulkan renderer (shadPS4 video core)
notes: Boots, renders, controller works, sound effects and ATRAC9 music work, launcher with folder picker and auto-retry. Known issues: occasional crash at startup (the launcher retries), no volume/pan, no window or resolution options yet. Tested on one machine and one game version. Needs your own copy of the game; none is included. Fork of gow3_pc.
